      • DividendData

        public DividendData(int daysToMaturity,
                    double dividend,
                    double interest)
        Parameters:
        daysToMaturity - is the number of days until this option expires.
        dividend - is the underlying stock's dividend rate.
        interest - is the risk-free interest rate, such as the current 13-week Treasury bill rate. Use the decimal form of the rate (rate/100). Example: For 2%, use 0.02.
